note: Verified against official vendor pages by paired research+verify agents. Edit freely; run_all.py renders features.html from this.

hosting.note: 'Hosting is included in the price of the paid subscription' - Google Cloud infrastructure, PCI-DSS Level 1 security, CDN in 199+ territories, daily backups, own-SSL install supported

eu_local.note: Bulgarian platform: one-click local gateways (ePay, Borica WAY4, myPOS, Paysera, Fibank/UBB/DSK vPOS, TBI/UniCredit/BNP/DSK financing), Econt/Speedy couriers, monthly NRA audit file, automated EU VAT with real-time VIES validation, invoicing engine, full Bulgarian-language site and support

support.note: AI агент поема първа линия мигновено, 24/7 (съзнателна стратегия, не спестяване); телефон, лични срещи и Customer Success Manager на CC Pro/Master; поддръжка на български

gmv_caps.note: Every plan carries a six-month turnover cap - EUR 9,999 (Baby), 24,999 (Starter), 249,999 (CC Pro), 499,999 (CC Master) - forcing an upgrade (custom 'Unicorn' plan above that); product caps 100/2,000/7,500/unlimited also apply

CloudCart.summary: CloudCart's strongest cards are 0% transaction fees on all plans, all-inclusive Google Cloud hosting with CDN and PCI-DSS L1, a genuine B2B store module, CloudIO AI copy/SEO tools, and unmatched Bulgaria/EU localization (ePay, Borica, myPOS, Paysera and bank vPOS integrations, monthly NRA audit files, automated EU VAT with VIES validation, Bulgarian-language support). Honest weaknesses: no native POS for physical retail, headless commerce still 'coming soon' with plan-gated API rate limits, multi-language/multi-currency handled through an app with per-language-version currencies rather than a true switcher, AI-first support with humans (phone/meetings) only on higher plans, a small app ecosystem (~160 apps), and six-month turnover caps (EUR 9,999-499,999) that force plan upgrades as merchants grow.

free_tier.note: No free plan: free 3-day trial (no credit card), then 1 EUR/month for the first 3 months on most plans; paid plans from 27 EUR/mo (Basic).

txn_fees.note: 0% only with Shopify Payments; third-party payment providers incur platform fees of 2% (Basic), 1% (Grow), 0.6% (Advanced), 0.2% (Plus) on top of processor charges.

pos.note: POS Pro 79 €/мес. на локация (годишно), но Shopify Payments не поддържа POS плащания в България: нужен е външен терминал и процесор на трета страна с допълнителна такса 0,6–2 %

b2b.note: "If you're on a Plus plan, B2B on Shopify is included at no extra cost": company profiles, custom catalogs, price lists, net terms; requires Plus (from 2100 EUR/mo).

multilang.note: Multi-language storefronts supported via Markets, but translation content needs Shopify's free first-party Translate & Adapt app: auto-translates only 2 languages free, unlimited manual translations.

multicurrency.note: Shopify Markets: "Local languages and currencies: localize your store for each region; with Shopify Payments, people can pay in local currency" with dynamic FX rates.

ai_tools.note: Sidekick, an "AI-enabled commerce assistant" to start/run/grow the business, plus Shopify Magic AI generation of product descriptions, images and store content, included across plans.

app_store.note: Shopify App Store advertises 16,000 apps: by far the largest ecommerce app ecosystem.

api_headless.note: Full Storefront API (GraphQL) plus the Hydrogen framework: "everything you need to build fast, and deliver personalized shopping experiences" headless.

hosting.note: "Shopify includes secure, unlimited ecommerce hosting... unlimited bandwidth (no bandwidth fees) and provides a free TLS/SSL certificate" on all plans.

eu_local.note: Shopify Payments IS now available in Bulgaria (cards, Apple/Google Pay, EU local methods like iDEAL|Wero, Bancontact; EUR pricing ~1.9%+0.25 EUR online); Shopify Tax auto-calculates EU VAT by location but does not file/remit VAT or issue local fiscal invoices natively.

support.note: 24/7 chat support on all plans, offered in ~20 languages including Bulgarian ("Poddrazhka 24/7 na balgarski": support staff plus virtual Help Center assistant); priority options on higher plans, no standard inbound phone line.

gmv_caps.note: No GMV caps or setup fees on standard plans, but Shopify Plus pricing carries "online variable platform fees" that scale with volume (lowered by committing to a 3-year term).

Shopify.summary: Shopify's strengths are ecosystem and completeness: a 16,000-app marketplace, native POS on every plan, Sidekick/Magic AI included, full Storefront API + Hydrogen headless stack, Markets multicurrency, and 24/7 chat support in Bulgarian — and Shopify Payments is now live in Bulgaria, removing its historic weakness there. Its weaknesses for a Bulgarian merchant pitch: no free plan (3-day trial then 1 EUR/mo promo), 0.2-2% platform transaction fees whenever a third-party/local payment provider is used instead of Shopify Payments, B2B locked behind Plus (from 2100 EUR/mo with volume-based variable platform fees), translation requiring the Translate & Adapt app (only 2 auto-translated languages free), and no native EU VAT filing or local fiscal invoicing.

free_tier.note: No free plan; fully functional 15-day free trial, no credit card required, store deleted 90 days after trial if no plan chosen

txn_fees.note: $0 fee only with Embedded Payment Providers (Stripe, PayPal, Adyen, etc.); an 'Open Payment Provider Fee' of 2.0% (Core), 1.0% (Growth), 0.6% (Scale) applies to orders through any other gateway: the old blanket '0% transaction fees' claim no longer holds

pos.note: No native POS: 'complete freedom to choose the POS provider' via partners (PayPal Zettle, Clover, Heartland Retail, ConnectPOS, Vend, Hike, Epos Now); only BOPIS APIs are native

b2b.note: Strong B2B via B2B Edition (buyer portal, company hierarchies, quotes/CPQ, net terms, approval workflows) but it is a paid upgrade product ('invest in our award-winning B2B Edition'); native Price Lists are gated to the top Performance tier

multilang.note: 'Each storefront can only support a single language': multi-language means a separate storefront per language (add-on storefronts $30-$100/mo, capped at 3/5/8 by plan) or third-party apps; Bulgarian is not among the ~15 supported theme system-string languages

multicurrency.note: Display (active) currencies on all plans with static/dynamic rates and per-currency price lists, but transactional multi-currency officially supports only the Stripe gateway ('Other Payment Gateways: Not Supported')

ai_tools.note: BigAI Copywriter (product descriptions, English only) is live and free; Product Recommendations and Predictive Analytics are 'coming soon, exclusively for Enterprise plans'; AI search/chat comes from partners (Klevu, Bloomreach, Searchspring); no AI store builder

app_store.note: Official marketplace with 'over 1,200 apps' plus certified technology and agency partner programs

api_headless.note: 'API-first' with full REST + GraphQL Storefront APIs, the open-source Catalyst Next.js storefront framework, and integrations for Next.js/Gatsby/Nuxt and CMSs (WordPress, Contentful, Prismic, Contentstack); no plan restriction stated

hosting.note: Fully hosted SaaS with free sitewide HTTPS and dedicated SSL on every plan, 99.98% uptime since 2009 (100% during Cyber Week since 2016), ISO/SOC/PCI/GDPR certifications

eu_local.note: EUR supported and embedded providers include pan-EU processors (Stripe, Adyen, PayPal, Klarna, Checkout.com), but no Bulgarian local processors (no ePay/Borica/myPOS on the embedded list, so local gateways would incur the Open Provider fee), no bigcommerce.com Bulgaria site, and EU VAT/OSS invoicing is not built in: only tax-inclusive display and tax zones via settings/API or third-party tax providers

support.note: 24/7 chat and email support on all plans; 24/7 phone included on Growth, Scale and Performance (phone is a paid add-on 'coming soon' for Core); support is English-language

gmv_caps.note: Hard GMV caps with forced auto-upgrades: Core ($29-39/mo) caps at $30K TTM GMV then auto-upgrades to Growth ($79-105/mo), Growth caps at $100K then auto-upgrades to Scale ($299-399/mo), Scale caps at $33,333/mo GMV with a 0.9% overage fee above it and auto-upgrade to custom-priced Performance (from $1,499/mo) at $2M TTM

BigCommerce.summary: BigCommerce's strengths are enterprise-grade openness: full REST/GraphQL APIs with the Catalyst headless framework, a 1,200+ app marketplace, robust (plan-gated) B2B Edition, and fully managed hosting with free SSL and strong uptime. Its weaknesses are pricing traps and localization gaps: GMV-based forced auto-upgrades (Core $30K -> Growth $100K -> Scale, with 0.9% overage on Scale and auto-upgrade to $1,499+/mo Performance at $2M TTM), a 0.6-2.0% fee on any non-embedded payment provider that undercuts the "0% transaction fees" pitch, no native POS (partners only), one language per storefront (extra storefronts cost $30-100/mo each), and transactional multi-currency officially limited to Stripe. For Bulgaria/EU, EUR and pan-EU gateways work but there are no local Bulgarian processors on the fee-free embedded list and no built-in EU VAT/OSS invoicing.

free_tier.note: No free plan: every site starts with a 14-day free trial, no credit card required

txn_fees.note: 2% commerce fee on Basic (0% on Core/Plus/Advanced), plus a separate Digital Products fee of 7%/5%/1%/0% by plan; invoices exempt

pos.note: Squarespace POS app is US- and UK-only (Square Reader US only): unusable in Bulgaria/EU retail

b2b.note: Only manual branded invoices to 'clients and wholesalers': no wholesale storefront, customer-specific pricing, or bulk ordering

multilang.note: No native multilingual: built-in text (e.g. checkout) displays in one language only; requires manual page duplication or the third-party Weglot integration

multicurrency.note: 'You can only sell in one currency at a time'; EUR supported as store currency, BGN is not

ai_tools.note: Blueprint AI site builder + Design Intelligence AI copy (product descriptions, email, blogs, SEO); metered AI Credits by plan: 10 one-time on Basic up to 120/month on Advanced

app_store.note: Squarespace Extensions is a small third-party directory (~60+ integrations in 4 categories: shipping, inventory, finance, marketing): no true app platform

api_headless.note: Read/sync Commerce APIs only (Orders, Products, Inventory, Transactions, Webhooks), plan-gated to Core+; no cart/checkout API, so no real headless storefront

hosting.note: Fully hosted with SSL security and unlimited bandwidth on all plans

eu_local.note: Squarespace Payments covers only 10 EU countries and NOT Bulgaria: Bulgarian merchants must use Stripe or PayPal; EUR stores work and automated EU VAT incl. OSS is on Core+ plans, but no BGN and no local processors

support.note: 24/7 email plus live chat Mon-Fri 4am-8pm ET (English; French/German chat 10am-4pm CET); explicitly no phone support, no Bulgarian

gmv_caps.note: No turnover/GMV caps: 'Sell unlimited products and services' on all plans; upgrade pressure comes from Basic's 2%/7% fees, not sales limits

Squarespace.summary: Squarespace's strengths are design-led simplicity: all-inclusive hosting/SSL/bandwidth, strong AI tooling (Blueprint AI, Design Intelligence with plan-metered AI credits), no GMV caps, and automated EU VAT with OSS on Core and above. Its weaknesses for EU/Bulgarian e-commerce are structural: single-currency stores (no BGN), no native multilingual (Weglot add-on or manual duplication), POS limited to the US/UK, Squarespace Payments unavailable in Bulgaria (Stripe/PayPal only), a tiny extensions directory, and sync-only APIs with no headless checkout. Transaction fees bite on the entry plan — 2% on commerce plus up to 7% on digital products until you climb the plan ladder — and support is chat/email only with no phone and no Bulgarian-language option.

free_tier.note: $0 End-to-End plan (a $229/mo value) is US merchants only and runs on Shift4 Payments; non-US merchants get no free plan (an 'unlimited, enterprise-grade plan for $41/month'), and a 'monthly SaaS fee may be charged depending on your plan and monthly processing amount'

txn_fees.note: 0% on all plans: 'No additional transaction fees'; FAQ: 'you only pay the normal fees required by your payment processor'

b2b.note: Dedicated B2B eCommerce solution ('sell B2C at the same time from the same website') with built-in Customer Groups, wholesale/bulk quantity discounts, Quote System, Purchase Order module and Sales Rep module on standard plans

support.note: 24x7 tech support on all plans: online chat, tickets and phone (1-800-828-6650, a US toll-free number); documentation and support in English only

gmv_caps.note: Paid plans cap online sales at $100k (Basic), $250k (Plus) and $1M (Pro) per year, and 'you will be automatically upgraded to the next plan' once trailing-12-month sales hit the cap; over $1M requires Enterprise; only the US-only free End-to-End plan has no revenue caps Извън САЩ: платени планове от 29 $ (с лимити) или E2E вариантът за 41 $/мес. без лимити.

Shift4Shop.summary: Shift4Shop's pitch is feature depth for money: every plan gets unlimited products, REST API access, B2B modules (customer groups, quotes, POs), 24/7 chat/phone support, hosting/SSL/domain included, and 0% transaction fees — with a genuinely free unlimited plan for US merchants who process through Shift4 Payments. Internationally it collapses: no free plan outside the US ($41/mo, PayPal-based payments), some countries blocked from signup entirely, one language per store with Latin-alphabet-only support (Bulgarian Cyrillic impossible), display-only multi-currency via a paid third-party app, and only a basic VAT-display module. Momentum is also a liability — no AI tooling, a small app store still branded '3dcart' with dead listings, a vanished POS offering, and forced automatic upgrades when paid plans hit $100k/$250k/$1M GMV caps.

app_store.note: Wix App Market with hundreds of first- and third-party apps across Sell Online, Marketing, Chat and CRM categories; many apps are 'Premium Site Required' or separately paid

api_headless.note: Wix Headless gives full REST APIs + JavaScript SDK with 'no API fees' and frontends hosted on Vercel/Netlify/AWS, but payments always run through the Wix-hosted secure checkout

hosting.note: 'Wix provides secure and free web hosting as soon as you publish your site'; every paid plan includes multi-cloud hosting, SSL/DNS handled for you, PCI DSS Level 1

Wix.summary: Wix's strengths are price-side: a real free plan, 0% platform commission on store sales (processing fees only, ~1.9% + EUR 0.30 in the EU), no GMV caps, AI site/copy/image generation, a 180+ language multilingual app, a large App Market and bundled hosting/SSL. Its weaknesses for the Bulgarian/EU market are that Wix Payments and Wix POS are unavailable in Bulgaria (merchants fall back to PayPal/Stripe/SumUp/Fondy/Tranzzo, POS not at all), B2B/wholesale requires the third-party SparkLayer app, multi-currency works only with specific providers, and headless builds still funnel through Wix-hosted checkout. Selling requires at least the Core paid plan, and support has no Bulgarian-language channel.

free_tier.note: No free plan or free trial anymore: 'we offer four paid plans (Starter, Venture, Business, and Unlimited)'; entry is Starter at $5/mo with a 10-product cap (nonprofits can get 6 months of Venture free)

txn_fees.note: 0% on all plans: pricing FAQ states 'we don't charge any setup or transaction fees on any of our plans'; comparison table shows $0/€0 transaction fees on every tier

pos.note: Mobile point-of-sale via the Ecwid app for in-person cash sales; real POS is integration-based and plan-gated: Lightspeed Retail POS (X-Series) sync on Business+, Square and Clover POS only on Unlimited ($149/mo) and in limited countries

b2b.note: Wholesale pricing groups (exclusive storewide discounts for wholesale client groups) from the Business plan ($65/mo); customer groups and manually created orders exist, but no full B2B suite (no quotes, net terms, or company accounts)

multilang.note: Multilingual catalog with storefront language switcher is gated to Business ($65/mo) and Unlimited plans; Instant Site website translation only on the new-gen Instant Site

multicurrency.note: One currency per store: multi-currency display only via App Market apps (Currency Converter, $4.49/mo, Venture+ required); ~130 currencies shown but 'at checkout, your customers will pay in the main currency of your store'

ai_tools.note: Built-in AI writes, formats, and translates product descriptions and SEO copy: but 'Plan availability: Unlimited' ($149/mo) only; AI image background removal/enhancer and AI domain suggestions are built in; no AI store builder or shopping agent

app_store.note: Ecwid App Market with free and paid apps on all four plans per support docs (pricing page markets 'Access to App Market' from Venture $35/mo); key gaps like multi-currency and marketplaces are paid apps with extra monthly fees

api_headless.note: REST API only on Venture ($35/mo) and higher: not on Starter; JavaScript Storefront API on all plans, plus webhooks and custom-app docs, so headless/custom storefronts are possible on paid mid-tiers

hosting.note: Fully hosted SaaS with free company.site domain including TLS/SSL certificate on all plans; pricing FAQ: 'all Ecwid plans come with unlimited bandwidth and storage at no extra cost'

eu_local.note: EUR billing, automatic EU VAT rates, tax invoices with VAT ID, reverse charge, and OSS/IOSS guidance are built in; Bulgaria gateway list = Stripe and PayPal on Starter, plus Viva Wallet, Revolut, 2Checkout, MultiSafepay, SEPA (via Stripe) etc. on Venture+: no Bulgarian local processors (ePay.bg, Borica, myPOS) listed

support.note: Support tier is plan-gated: email only on Starter; live chat 24h Mon-Fri from Venture; phone is call-backs 2PM-10PM PDT Mon-Fri in English, scheduled via chat, from Business; priority queue on Unlimited: awkward hours and English-only phone for Bulgarian/EU merchants

gmv_caps.note: No turnover/GMV caps or overage fees: upgrade pressure comes from product-count caps instead: 10 (Starter), 100 (Venture), 2,500 (Business), unlimited (Unlimited)

Ecwid.summary: Ecwid by Lightspeed's strengths are genuine 0% transaction fees on every plan, embedding a store into any existing website, fully hosted infrastructure with unlimited bandwidth/storage and free SSL, and solid EU VAT automation (automatic rates, VAT-ID invoices, OSS/IOSS guidance). Its weaknesses are that the famous free plan is gone (entry is a $5/mo, 10-product Starter tier), tight product-count caps drive upgrades, and much of the platform is plan-gated: REST API and most payment gateways need Venture ($35/mo), multilingual catalog, wholesale pricing, and phone support need Business ($65/mo), and built-in AI product copy plus Square/Clover POS need Unlimited ($149/mo). Multi-currency is display-only via a paid app (checkout stays in one currency), POS is integration-based rather than truly native, and phone support is English-only on US Pacific hours — real openings for a locally supported, EUR/BGN-native platform like CloudCart.

free_tier.note: Core plugin is 100% free, open-source (GPL), 7+ million active installs, 4.5/5 stars from 4,813 reviews: but 'free' covers software only: hosting, domain, and most serious features are paid add-ons.

txn_fees.note: No platform transaction fees on any gateway. Optional WooPayments is pay-as-you-go with 'no setup fees, monthly fees... or other hidden charges': EU cards 1.5% + €0.25 (US 2.9% + $0.30), +2% international cards, +2% currency conversion, €15 dispute fee.

pos.note: No native POS. Official route is the free 'Square for WooCommerce' extension (syncs inventory/orders with Square POS): but Square is available in only 8 countries (US, CA, AU, JP, UK, FR, ES, IE), NOT Bulgaria; extension rated 3.4/5 (129 reviews). Other POS = third-party plugins.

b2b.note: 'B2B for WooCommerce' extension costs €157/year: role-based wholesale pricing, tiered quantity pricing, quote-request system with PDF quotes, registration approval, tax exemption, per-role payment/shipping restrictions.

multilang.note: No native multilingual. WPML 'Multilingual CMS' tier (the minimum with WooCommerce e-commerce support) costs €99/year; Polylang has a free core but Polylang for WooCommerce is paid (~€99/yr).

multicurrency.note: Multi-currency is built into WooPayments at no extra cost (customers pay in a currency list you define, geo-based auto-switching, custom rates/rounding): but 'it does not mean you can accept payouts in multiple currencies'; payouts stay in one currency. Without WooPayments you need a paid extension.

ai_tools.note: No bundled AI suite. Core has native MCP (Model Context Protocol) support 'enabling AI assistants and tools to interact directly with WooCommerce stores'; merchant-facing AI (recommendations, shopping assistant, 40+ languages, OpenAI-powered) is the paid 'AI Product Recommendations' extension at €35/year.

app_store.note: Official Woo Marketplace advertises 'hundreds of free and paid extensions' (third-party count: ~750 listed, only ~85 developed by Woo); plus the wider WordPress.org repo with tens of thousands of free plugins and 100+ payment gateways. Quality/compatibility vetting varies by vendor.

api_headless.note: REST API v3 lets 'WC data be created, read, updated, and deleted using requests in JSON format', with official libraries in JavaScript, PHP, Python and Ruby: full headless builds are possible but entirely DIY (you build and host the front end yourself).

hosting.note: Hosting NOT included: self-hosted by design; woocommerce.com only lists 7 recommended partners (WordPress.com, Pressable, Bluehost, Hostinger, SiteGround...). Real managed-Woo prices: SiteGround $2.99–7.99/mo promo renewing at $17.99–44.99/mo; WordPress.com Commerce plan €45/mo (annual) / €70 month-to-month.

eu_local.note: WooPayments explicitly supports Bulgaria and all 26 other EU states (40+ countries, accepts 100+ currencies); EU e-invoicing via free 'PDF Invoices & Packing Slips' plugin (300,000+ installs, UBL 2.1/Peppol BIS 3.0/Factur-X, auto-attached to order emails). But no vendor-localized BG offering, no Bulgarian-language vendor support, and Square POS excludes Bulgaria: local gateways/couriers depend on third-party plugins.

support.note: No vendor support for the free plugin: helpdesk (live chat/email) covers only products purchased on woocommerce.com, explicitly excludes customizations and 'hosting issues fall outside the support scope entirely'; free users rely on community forums and their hosting company. Only latest + one previous version supported.

gmv_caps.note: No GMV caps, revenue-based tiers, or forced plan upgrades: open-source GPL software where merchants 'retain full ownership of store content and data' and can use any of 100+ payment gateways with zero platform commission.

WooCommerce.summary: WooCommerce is free open-source software with 7M+ installs, no GMV caps, no platform transaction fees, full data ownership, and a REST API plus hundreds-strong extension marketplace: but "free" is only the plugin: the merchant assembles and pays for hosting, security, updates, backups, and per-feature annual licenses (multilingual €99/yr, B2B €157/yr, AI €35/yr) with no vendor support for the core product and hosting issues explicitly out of support scope. That is the honest migration angle: merchants leave self-hosted Woo for managed platforms to escape the maintenance/security/plugin-conflict burden and unpredictable stacked costs, while Woo keeps winning on ownership, unlimited customization, and the absence of caps or platform commissions: so position against its total cost of ownership and operational risk, not its price tag.
WooCommerce.costs: Realistic small-store monthly run-rate: managed Woo hosting $18–45/mo at renewal (SiteGround StartUp $17.99 → GoGeek $44.99/mo after the $2.99–7.99 first-year promo: siteground.com/woocommerce-hosting.htm) or bundled WordPress.com Commerce €45/mo billed annually (wordpress.com/pricing/); domain ~€1/mo; typical essential paid extensions €10–30/mo amortized (e.g. WPML Multilingual CMS €99/yr: wpml.org/purchase/; AI Product Recommendations €35/yr; B2B for WooCommerce €157/yr: woocommerce.com product pages; invoicing free via PDF Invoices & Packing Slips). Total ≈ €30–75/month for a small store before payment processing (WooPayments EU: 1.5% + €0.25 per card transaction, no monthly fee: woocommerce.com/document/woopayments/fees-and-debits/); first-year promos can dip under €10/mo but renewal pricing roughly triples hosting cost, and a developer/agency retainer for updates and security is a common hidden extra.

positioning.note: Курирано от екипа върху проверените факти; редактирайте свободно.

differentiators.title: AI екосистема от три агента
differentiators.note: 1) AI агент за поддръжка от първа линия, мигновен и денонощен; 2) AI асистент на магазина, който управлява каталога, поръчките и операциите на търговеца; 3) AI консиерж на витрината: 24/7 продажбен асистент, който отговаря на клиентите и ги води към правилния продукт. Конкурентите имат най-много админ-асистент (Shopify Sidekick); никой не покрива и трите роли.

differentiators.title: 0% такси + пълна локализация за България и ЕС
differentiators.note: Комбинация, която никой друг няма: 0% комисиони на всички планове заедно с ePay, Borica, myPOS, банкови vPOS, Econt/Speedy, месечен одит файл за НАП и автоматичен ЕС ДДС с VIES.

differentiators.title: Индивидуални условия за enterprise клиенти
differentiators.note: Enterprise клиентите работят на индивидуален договор: разширени API лимити, персонализации на ниво платформа и checkout, интеграции по спецификация (ERP, складови и платежни системи), пряк канал към инженерния екип и отделно SLA. Стандартният SaaS модел на конкурентите ограничава този клас клиенти до конфигурация в рамките на продукта.

differentiators.title: Вграден B2B модул
differentiators.note: Ценови групи, достъп само за регистрирани, бързи едрови поръчки и VIES проверка: при 5 от 6 конкуренти това липсва или е скъпа добавка.

Финансово: Най-ниска входна цена в групата (14 €/мес.) при включен хостинг, CDN и сигурност PCI-DSS L1
0% комисиони срещу 0,6–2% при Shopify без Shopify Payments и 2% при Squarespace Basic
Технология: Три AI агента в продукта: поддръжка, управление на магазина, клиентски консиерж на витрината: агентна търговия в действие, не обещание
CloudIO: AI описания (VisionSense от снимки), RankMaster AI SEO на всички планове
REST и GraphQL API с документация
Headless е обявен, но не е пуснат; конкурентите (Shopify Hydrogen, BigCommerce) вече продават с него
Около 160 приложения срещу хиляди при Shopify и Wix
Няма собствен POS за физическа търговия (Shopify POS, Square, Lightspeed)
Маркетинг: Видим обем: Shopify върти 70 000–80 000 Google реклами и постоянно видео, ние: 0 видеа за последните 30 дни и без видими Google реклами (по данни от собствения ни мониторинг)
Squarespace и BigCommerce публикуват директно сравнително съдържание; никой не отговаря от наша страна
Финансово: Лимити на оборота на всеки план принуждават ъпгрейд; Wix и Squarespace нямат такива
Годишните ни цени са промоция за първата година: при подновяване разликата с конкурентите се свива
